faq.q: Is Leonida Penitentiary confirmed to be in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. It is named directly in Rockstar's official character biography for Lucia Caminos, one of the two playable protagonists of Grand Theft Auto VI.

faq.q: Why is Lucia Caminos in Leonida Penitentiary?
faq.a: The record does not give a reason. Rockstar's bio only states that Lucia is incarcerated there at the start of the game, before the central story begins.

faq.q: Has Leonida Penitentiary been shown in a trailer?
faq.a: No. It has not yet been shown visually in trailer footage, even though it is named in Rockstar's official character bio for Lucia.

faq.q: Where is Leonida Penitentiary located on the map?
faq.a: Not known. Its location within Leonida has not yet been mapped in any official or press material.

faq.q: Is Jason Duval connected to Leonida Penitentiary too?
faq.a: The record only ties Lucia Caminos to Leonida Penitentiary. It does not mention Jason in connection with this location.

notKnown: Whether the prison will be shown on screen or made visitable in the finished game.
howWeKnow: Leonida Penitentiary comes from Rockstar's own official character biography for Lucia Caminos, reported by ScreenRant. Because it is a first-party naming rather than a leak, it is one of the more reliably sourced named locations in Leonida, even though no trailer has shown it on screen yet.
